title: Mastering Next.js App Router & Server Components
excerpt: Discover how Next.js transforms full-stack React development with server-side rendering, streaming, and component architecture.
content: Next.js has fundamentally shifted how web applications are architected. By introducing React Server Components into the App Router, developers can fetch data on the server with zero client-side JavaScript runtime overhead. This architecture provides lightning-fast initial page loads, improved SEO performance out of the box, and intuitive directory-based routing.
author: Alex Rivera

title: What's New in Tailwind CSS v4 Engine
excerpt: A deep dive into the performance gains, CSS-first configuration, and native browser features in modern Tailwind CSS.
content: Tailwind CSS v4 introduces a reimagined compilation engine built for extreme speed. By moving configuration straight into CSS files via standard imports, developers no longer need heavy JavaScript config files for basic setups. Combining container queries, modern color spaces like OKLCH, and native nesting makes building feel-good user interfaces faster than ever.
author: Devon Chen

title: Essential Git Workflows for Modern Teams
excerpt: Move beyond basic commits and pushes to master rebasing, stashing, and conflict-free branch management.
content: While basic Git commands like commit and push cover daily essentials, mastering interactive rebasing and stashing turns version control into a superpower. Stashing allows you to quickly isolate working progress when switching context, while clean rebase strategies prevent noisy merge commits in shared repositories.
author: Sarah Jenkins

title: Zero-Downtime Deployments with Vercel & GitHub Actions
excerpt: How automated CI/CD pipelines and Vercel preview environments streamline shipping production code.
content: Continuous integration is the backbone of high-velocity development teams. Linking your GitHub repository directly to Vercel provides automatic preview URLs for every pull request, allowing teammates to test features in isolated environments before hitting production.
author: Elena Rostova
